pages.title: Flight Control
pages.text: Create: Flight Control adds computers that decide how much each thruster should push. You link parts together with a tool gun instead of wiring redstone.

pages.title: Flight Control Tool Gun
pages.text: Select an [#](2E5AAC)[engine](entry://flight/propulsion)[#]() or controller, then right-click the computer to link it. Also links tanks, sensors and seats.

pages.title: Flight Control Computer
pages.text: Allocates thrust to meet the demand of linked controllers. [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() show how many engines and controllers are active.

pages.title: Smart Attitude Stabilizer
pages.text: Modes: Level, Level plus Heading, and Hold Attitude. Needs shaft [#](2E5AAC)[stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]() from below and a linked computer.

pages.title: Altitude Hold Block
pages.text: Holds the current height, a set height, or only lifts when below a minimum. Needs shaft power.

pages.title: Flight Control Terminal
pages.text: Mouse-driven flight with pitch, yaw and auto bank. Bind a seat to it with the tool gun first.

pages.title: Getting it to fly
pages.text:
A new computer only previews thrust and moves nothing. Open it empty-handed, set **Default: ON** and press **Apply Thrust**.\
\
The craft keeps its last course when you leave the seat. Set the computer to Default: OFF to stop it.

pages.title: Mouse steering
pages.text:
Open the Terminal empty-handed, turn it on and press Apply.\
\
Then link a Redstone Proxy to the Terminal, map one face to **Mouse Control Switch** and put a button on that face. Each press turns mouse steering on or off.

pages.title: Smart Vector Thruster
pages.text: A thruster whose nozzle swings inside a cone to push in the direction the computer asks for.

pages.title: More parts
pages.text:
Other parts:

- Flight HUD Projector, Attitude Display, Navigation Terminal and Profile Builder
- couplers for speed and distance
- a Redstone Proxy that lets redstone toggle modes

Fuel tanks link to thrusters within a short range.
